# `gmail.status`

Content-free Gmail-voice freshness and coverage snapshot: stored and eligible message counts, the persisted historyId cursor to resume from, when you last ran gmail.import, and a stale/fresh verdict. CLI-only: pass --brief for one plain-text line suited to a session-start hook instead of full JSON.

- **group:** `read`
- **posture:** `safe`
- **CLI:** `operator-voice gmail-status`
- **MCP tool:** `gmail_status`

## Examples

```
operator-voice gmail-status
```
```
operator-voice gmail-status --brief
```

## Errors

| code | what it means |
|---|---|
| `invalid_arguments` | An argument was missing, had the wrong type, or wasn't one of the allowed choices — nothing changed. |
